caption: The drawing depicts an architectural arch rendered in shades of beige and light brown, giving the appearance of aged stone. The arch features intricate moldings with angular, stepped profiles, and includes a central keystone at the top. On both the left and right upper corners of the arch are sculpted reliefs of human figures clad in classical attire, each holding a cluster of grapes with vine leaves and scrollwork surrounding them. Visible cracks run through the keystone and both corners, as well as through some of the ornamentation, suggesting damage or aging of the stone. The overall composition is symmetrical except for the direction of the figures and their positioning relative to the vines. The name "EMILE A. CERO" is printed in small capital letters in the lower right quadrant beneath the right side of the arch. The background is plain and neutral, highlighting the details of the arch without distraction.
title: Carved Stone Arch Over Doorway
